id.description: Unique identifier of the fulfillment event

fulfillment_id.description: Unique identifier of the fulfillment the event belongs to

order_id.description: Unique identifier of the order the fulfillment belongs to

status.description: Status of the fulfillment at the time of the event

happened_at.description: Date and time when the event occurred

estimated_delivery_at.description: Estimated delivery date and time reported with the event

province.description: Province or state where the event occurred

zip.description: Zip or postal code where the event occurred

address1.description: Street address where the event occurred

created_at.description: Date and time when the event was created

updated_at.description: Date and time when the event was last updated

admin_graphql_api_id.description: Unique identifier of the event in the Admin GraphQL API

shop_url.description: URL of the shop the event belongs to
